newsitem.title: USA: Datascope says sales fell at two units.
newsitem.headline: Datascope says sales fell at two units.

text.p: Datascope Corp said sales at its Cardiac Assist Division and InterVascular Inc businesses declined in the company's fiscal third quarter.
The company cited competitive pressures for the decline at Cardiac Assist and price cuts for the year-over-year sales fall at InterVascular.

It said it expected InterVascular's sales growth to resume upon receipt of market clearances for its InterGard collagen-coated graft in the U.S. and Japan. It said it expects Cardiac Assist's market to remain competitive.
The company also said its VasoSeal business turned a quarterly profit for the first time in its history in the just-concluded third quarter, with annualized sales rising 42 percent.
